## Overview
AiWCRM is an enterprise-grade AI Customer Engagement Platform built on the Meta Official Cloud API. It provides Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) multi-model AI routing with 0% token markup, Retell Voice AI agent integrations, visual drag-and-drop Kanban sales pipelines, multi-agent shared team inboxes with typing collision detection, Meta broadcast campaign management, and sub-50ms developer REST APIs.

## Core Pillars & System Capabilities

### 1. BYOK Multi-LLM AI Routing Engine
- Connect your own API keys from Google Gemini 3.6, OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Groq LLaMA 3.3, or DeepSeek R1.
- Verified 0% platform token markup — businesses pay direct provider API rates.
- Sub-1-second self-healing AI auto-failover: if a primary model hits rate limits or latency spikes, AiWCRM instantly fails over to secondary models without dropping conversation state.
- Zero-Token Greeting Cache: Dispatches welcome messages and catalog replies in under 100ms with 0 AI token consumption.

### 2. Retell Voice AI Phone Call Automation
- Deploys human-like Retell Voice AI agents to handle phone calls.
- Sub-600ms voice agent response latency.
- Automated transcript generation, real-time sentiment scoring, and two-way sync with WhatsApp text chats.

### 3. Visual Drag-and-Drop Sales Kanban
- Pipeline stages: Lead Inbound -> Qualified -> Demo Scheduled -> Proposal Sent -> Closed Won.
- Lead scoring, automated follow-up reminders, custom pipeline fields, and rep revenue attribution.

### 4. Multi-Agent Shared Team Inbox
- Real-time agent typing collision alerts to prevent duplicate rep responses.
- Private internal @mention notes and automated round-robin lead assignment.

### 5. Meta Official WhatsApp Broadcast Campaigns
- 98% guaranteed open rates using official Meta Cloud API templates.
- Interactive action buttons, quick replies, list messages, and real-time CTA tracking.

### 6. No-Code Visual Workflow Builder
- Visual drag-and-drop nodes for webhook triggers, AI evaluation steps, CRM stage updates, and conditional customer journey branching.

### 7. Sub-50ms Developer REST APIs & Webhooks
- Programmatic template sending, deal queries, AI routing execution, and sub-50ms webhook event dispatches.
- SDKs for Node.js, Python, cURL, and Go.

## Compliance & Security
- 100% Meta Official API Ban Protection.
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), audit logging, session telemetry.
- SOC2 & GDPR compliant data security standards with AES-256 encryption.

## Target Verticals
- Manufacturing & B2B Supply Chain
- Healthcare & Medical Clinics
- Education & Admissions Counseling
- Retail & D2C E-Commerce Cart Recovery
- Real Estate & Property Site Visit Scheduling
- BFSI & Fintech Document KYC Verification
